verses.text: Jesus called his twelve disciples and gave them authority to drive out unclean spirits and to heal every disease and sickness.
These are the names of the twelve apostles: first, Simon (also called Peter), and his brother Andrew; James son of Zebedee, and his brother John;
Philip and Bartholomew; Thomas and Matthew the tax collector; James son of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus (also called Thaddaeus);
Simon the Zealot, and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed Jesus.
Jesus sent these twelve out with these instructions: “Don’t go among the Gentiles or enter a Samaritan town.
Instead, go to the lost sheep of Israel.
As you go, announce: ‘The Kingdom of Heaven is near!’
Heal the sick, cleanse people with skin diseases, raise the dead, and drive out demons. You received freely, so give freely.
Don’t pack gold, silver, or copper money for your belts.
Don’t take a travel bag, an extra shirt, sandals, or a walking stick. Workers deserve their food.
When you enter a town or village, find someone worthy there and stay at that person’s home until you leave.
As you enter the home, greet its people.
If the home is worthy, let your peace rest on it. If it isn’t, let your peace return to you.
If anyone won’t welcome you or listen to your words, leave that home or town and shake its dust from your feet.
I’m telling you the truth: the land of Sodom and Gomorrah will have an easier time on judgment day than that town.
“Look, I’m sending you out like sheep among wolves. So be wise as snakes and innocent as doves.
Watch out for people. They’ll hand you over to councils and whip you in their synagogues.
Because of me, you’ll be brought before governors and kings as a witness to them and to the nations.
When they hand you over, don’t worry about what to say or how to say it. You’ll be given the words at that moment.
It won’t be you speaking; your Father’s Spirit will speak through you.
“Brother will hand over brother to be killed, and a father will hand over his child. Children will turn against their parents and have them put to death.
Everyone will hate you because of my name, but the one who stays faithful to the end will be saved.
When they persecute you in one town, escape to the next. I’m telling you the truth: you won’t finish going through Israel’s towns before the Son of Man comes.
“A disciple isn’t above the teacher, and a servant isn’t above the master.
It’s enough for the disciple to become like the teacher and the servant like the master. If they called the head of the household Beelzebul, imagine what they’ll call the rest of the household.
So don’t be afraid of them. Nothing covered up will stay unrevealed, and nothing hidden will stay unknown.
What I tell you in the dark, say out in the light. What you hear whispered, announce from the rooftops.
Don’t fear those who can kill the body but can’t kill the soul. Instead, fear the one who can destroy both soul and body in Gehenna.
“Aren’t two sparrows sold for a small coin? Yet not one falls to the ground apart from your Father’s care.
Even the hairs on your head have all been counted.
So don’t be afraid. You’re worth more than many sparrows.
“Everyone who acknowledges me in front of people, I’ll also acknowledge in front of my Father in heaven.
But whoever disowns me in front of people, I’ll also disown in front of my Father in heaven.
“Don’t think I came to bring peace to the earth. I didn’t come to bring peace, but a sword.
I came to set a man against his father, a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.
A person’s enemies will be members of their own household.
Anyone who loves their father or mother more than me isn’t worthy of me. Anyone who loves their son or daughter more than me isn’t worthy of me.
Anyone who won’t take up their cross and follow me isn’t worthy of me.
Whoever tries to hold on to their life will lose it, but whoever loses their life for my sake will find it.
“Whoever welcomes you welcomes me, and whoever welcomes me welcomes the one who sent me.

Whoever welcomes a prophet because that person is a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward. Whoever welcomes a righteous person because that person is righteous will receive a righteous person’s reward.
I’m telling you the truth: whoever gives even one of these little ones a cup of cold water because they’re my disciple will definitely receive a reward.”
